correctness.rationale: Gaussian conditioning produces the exact quadratic-energy estimator and captured variance 2(H/(V+eta))^2. Direct covariance-square integration yields H and the exact total variance. The identities H_prime=V_prime D and G_prime=(V+eta)D_prime give one positive-to-negative crossing, strict global uniqueness, boundary coverage, monotonicity in noise, and a unique finite interior high-noise limit. SymPy identities, 25 independently integrated covariance squares and 19,932 numerical competitors are supplementary verified evidence, not the global proof.

value.rationale: Accumulated squared state is a natural linear-quadratic monitoring cost. The theorem gives a complete exact one-observation design for every damping and noise strength, with a nontrivial all-parameter uniqueness proof, strict delayed-time effect under added noise, exact risk and finite interior high-noise location. At lambda=1 noiseless the location reduces risk by 30.52% relative to midpoint monitoring. It is not merely re-evaluating the linear OU integral, since the target belongs to second Gaussian chaos and has a distinct objective.
